the majority of patients with arterial hypertension and target organ damage (LVH, nephropathy) are treated with antihypertensive medication and have a low risk of cardiovascular events.

the incidence of hypertensiver organ damage is very high, and even after guideline-oriented treatment there is still a considerable increase in the prevalence of renal dysfunction.
